ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies rising-edge timing to the bus_access process (sequencing assignments to bus_rsp_o, enable and fifo_clr) and is forwarded to instantiated components (neoTRNG_inst, rnd_pool_fifo_inst).
ports.evidence: process sensitivity and rising_edge(clk_i); clk_i port mapped to neoTRNG_inst and rnd_pool_fifo_inst.

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Drives the reset branch that initializes bus_rsp_o, fifo_clr and enable on '0' and is passed to the instantiated components' reset ports.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ... in bus_access; rstn_i port mapped to neoTRNG_inst and rnd_pool_fifo_inst.

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Aggregates bus request fields (stb, rw, addr, data, etc.) that are consumed individually by this entity to control read/write behavior and FIFO access.
role: supplies fields used to control logic
ports.evidence: port declaration; individual fields used throughout bus_access and concurrent assignments.

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Bit 2 of the address selects register versus data read in bus_access and, combined with stb and rw, participates in the condition that enables fifo.re for FIFO reads.
role: gates FIFO read when combined with stb and rw
ports.evidence: uses bus_req_i.addr(2) in bus_access if to choose status vs data and in fifo.re concurrent assignment.

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Supplies write-data bits; specific bits (ctrl_en_c, ctrl_fifo_clr_c) are read during write transactions to set internal enable and fifo_clr registers.
role: feeds control bits for enable and fifo_clr
ports.evidence: enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) and fifo_clr <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_fifo_clr_c) inside bus_access write branch.

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced anywhere in this source; not read or tested by the entity.
ports.evidence: no occurrences beyond the port declaration.

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Gates handling of a bus transaction (if-statement) and is captured into bus_rsp_o.ack; it also contributes to the fifo.re enable expression used to pop the FIFO on reads.
role: drives response ack and helps gate FIFO read
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb; used in if (bus_req_i.stb='1') then ...; part of fifo.re concurrent conditional.

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Selects the write versus read path in bus_access (writes set internal control bits; reads produce bus_rsp_o.data) and is part of the fifo.re expression enabling FIFO reads.
role: gates write captures and read responses
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.rw = '1') then ... else ... ; bus_req_i.rw used in fifo.re concurrent assignment.

ports.name: bus_req_i.src

ports.evidence: no occurrences beyond the port declaration.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Constructs the response record from ack, err and data fields inside bus_access and exports that assembled response to the bus master.
ports.evidence: bus_access process assigns bus_rsp_o fields (ack, err, data) including reset assignment bus_rsp_o <= rsp_terminate_c.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Captured on the clock edge from bus_req_i.stb and provided as the ack bit of the bus response.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb inside rising_edge(clk_i) branch of bus_access.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Captured each cycle as the constant '0' and supplied as the error bit of the bus response.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.err <= '0' inside bus_access clocked process.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Assembles the 32-bit response data from control bits (enable), FIFO size, sim flag, FIFO avail and the FIFO read data slice; selected by addr(2) during reads.
role: carries status and data to bus master
assembled from internal signals and constants
ports.evidence: bus_access assigns bus_rsp_o.data slices: ctrl_en_c<=enable; ctrl_avail_c<=fifo.avail; data bits ctrl_data_msb_c..ctrl_data_lsb_c<=fifo.rdata or zeros.

ports.name: clk_i
ports.function: clock source for registers and cells
ports.functionality: Supplies the clock edge to internal processes and to instantiated neoTRNG_cell instances; it sequences debiasing and sampling registers (debias_sreg, debias_state, sample_en, sample_cnt, sample_sreg) and clocks each cell instance.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in debiasing and sampling_control processes; port map clk_i => neoTRNG_cell_inst.clk_i in generate.

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides asynchronous reset to clocked processes and is forwarded to each neoTRNG_cell; it forces registers to their reset values in reset branches and is passed to instances' rstn_i ports.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ... assignments in debiasing and sampling_control; port map rstn_i => neoTRNG_cell_inst.rstn_i in generate.

ports.name: enable_i
ports.functionality: Is sampled into internal sample_en on the clock edge and thereby enables or disables sampling; it sources sample_en which in turn controls cell enables and sampling counter behavior.
ports.evidence: sample_en <= enable_i inside rising_edge(clk_i) in sampling_control process.

ports.name: valid_o
ports.functionality: Exports the MSB bit of the internal sample_cnt as a ready/valid indicator to the consumer by presenting sample_cnt(sample_cnt'left) at the port.
ports.evidence: valid_o <= sample_cnt(sample_cnt'left) concurrent assignment.

ports.name: data_o
ports.functionality: Exports the 8-bit sampling shift register value sample_sreg unchanged to the consumer as the data output.
ports.evidence: data_o <= sample_sreg concurrent assignment.

ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides rising-edge timing to sequential processes; it sequences the en_shift_reg and synchronizer registers and the simulator inverter process when present, driving register updates inside the entity.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in en_shift_reg, synchronizer and inverter_sim_ff processes

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: When '0' it forces reset branches in sequential processes, clearing sreg and sync to zeros and preventing normal updates until released.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') branches in en_shift_reg and synchronizer processes

ports.name: en_i
ports.function: enable input for ring and shift register
ports.functionality: Is shifted into the en shift-register on clock edges and also controls latch behavior: when '0' latch(i) is forced '0', otherwise latch may hold or follow inv_out depending on sreg(i).
ports.evidence: en shifted in by sreg <= ... & en_i (en_shift_reg) and used in latch when (en_i = '0') condition

ports.name: en_o
ports.functionality: Drives the external en_o port from the most-significant bit of the internal en shift-register sreg, exporting the shift-register's head bit.
ports.evidence: continuous assignment en_o <= sreg(sreg'left)

ports.name: rnd_o
ports.functionality: Drives the external rnd_o port from synchronizer stage sync(1), exporting the sampled/synchronized ring-oscillator bit to the outside.
ports.evidence: continuous assignment rnd_o <= sync(1)

signals.name: enable
signals.functionality: Captured from bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) in a write transaction and reset to '0'; it drives neoTRNG_inst.enable_i, is reported in bus_rsp_o.data, and participates in fifo.clear logic.
signals.evidence: enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) in write branch; port mapped to neoTRNG_inst.enable_i; used in fifo.clear concurrent assignment.

signals.name: fifo_clr
signals.functionality: Captured from bus_req_i.data(ctrl_fifo_clr_c) on writes and reset to '0'; it contributes to fifo.clear (combined with enable) to clear the FIFO when asserted.
signals.evidence: fifo_clr <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_fifo_clr_c) in write branch; used in fifo.clear <= '1' when (enable = '0') or (fifo_clr = '1').

signals.name: fifo
signals.functionality: Aggregate record holding FIFO control, data and status fields; its fields are individually driven or derived and connected to the instantiated FIFO and TRNG.
role: forwards fields to/from instantiated FIFO and TRNG
signals.evidence: type fifo_t record declaration and field connections in port maps to neoTRNG_inst and rnd_pool_fifo_inst.

signals.name: fifo.we
signals.functionality: Driven by neoTRNG_inst.valid_o and forwarded to rnd_pool_fifo_inst.we_i to request writes into the FIFO when TRNG produces data.
role: carries TRNG valid to FIFO write port
signals.evidence: neoTRNG_inst port map valid_o => fifo.we; rnd_pool_fifo_inst port map we_i => fifo.we.

signals.name: fifo.re
signals.functionality: Derived combinationally from bus_req_i.stb, bus_req_i.rw and bus_req_i.addr(2) and forwarded to rnd_pool_fifo_inst.re_i to pop data on bus reads.
role: drives FIFO pop on bus read
signals.evidence: concurrent assignment fifo.re <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb='1') and (bus_req_i.rw='0') and (bus_req_i.addr(2)='1') else '0'; port mapped to rnd_pool_fifo_inst.re_i.

signals.name: fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Derived from enable and fifo_clr (clear asserted when enable='0' or fifo_clr='1') and forwarded to rnd_pool_fifo_inst.clear_i to clear or reset FIFO state as required.
signals.evidence: fifo.clear <= '1' when (enable = '0') or (fifo_clr = '1') else '0'; port mapped to rnd_pool_fifo_inst.clear_i.

signals.name: fifo.wdata
signals.functionality: Captured from neoTRNG_inst.data_o (TRNG output bytes) and forwarded to rnd_pool_fifo_inst.wdata_i for storage in the FIFO.
signals.evidence: neoTRNG_inst port map data_o => fifo.wdata; rnd_pool_fifo_inst port map wdata_i => fifo.wdata.

signals.name: fifo.rdata
signals.functionality: Captured from rnd_pool_fifo_inst.rdata_o and supplied into bus responses: its full 8-bit value is placed into a slice of bus_rsp_o.data during data reads.
role: supplies read data slice into bus response
signals.evidence: rnd_pool_fifo_inst port map rdata_o => fifo.rdata; bus_access assigns bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_data_msb_c downto ctrl_data_lsb_c) <= fifo.rdata.

signals.name: fifo.avail
signals.functionality: Captured from rnd_pool_fifo_inst.avail_o; reported into bus_rsp_o.data at bit ctrl_avail_c and used to select zero vs fifo.rdata when the CPU reads the data register.
signals.evidence: rnd_pool_fifo_inst port map avail_o => fifo.avail; bus_access tests fifo.avail to select bus_rsp_o.data <= (others=>'0') or fifo.rdata.

signals.name: fifo.half
signals.functionality: Captured from rnd_pool_fifo_inst.half_o and made available internally; not used elsewhere in this source.
signals.evidence: rnd_pool_fifo_inst port map half_o => fifo.half; no other references found.

signals.name: fifo.free
signals.functionality: Captured from rnd_pool_fifo_inst.free_o and available internally; not read or acted on elsewhere in this source.
signals.evidence: rnd_pool_fifo_inst port map free_o => fifo.free; no other references in the source.

signals.name: cell_en_in
signals.function: shifted enable inputs to entropy cells
signals.functionality: Constructed from sample_en for element 0 and from a shifted slice of cell_en_out for higher bits; it forwards the cell enable vector into each neoTRNG_cell.en_i via instance port maps.
signals.evidence: cell_en_in(0) <= sample_en and cell_en_in(NUM_CELLS-1 downto 1) <= cell_en_out(NUM_CELLS-2 downto 0) concurrent assignments.

signals.name: cell_en_out
signals.functionality: Driven by each neoTRNG_cell en_o port and presented as a vector; its bits are read back to build cell_en_in and the MSB is used in debias_state update.
signals.evidence: port map en_o => cell_en_out(i) in generate; cell_en_in assignment and debias_state <= ... cell_en_out(cell_en_out'left).

signals.name: cell_rnd
signals.functionality: Collects rnd_o from every instantiated neoTRNG_cell and supplies those bits to the combine process which XORs them into cell_sum.
signals.evidence: port map rnd_o => cell_rnd(i) in generate; used in combine process loop tmp_v := tmp_v xor cell_rnd(i).

signals.name: cell_sum
signals.functionality: Computed as the XOR (parity) of all bits in cell_rnd inside the combine process and provided as the single combined entropy bit to the debias shift register.
signals.evidence: process combine computes tmp_v xor cell_rnd loop and assigns cell_sum <= tmp_v.

signals.name: debias_sreg
signals.functionality: Clocked two-bit shift register that captures the newest cell_sum and previous bit each rising edge; its bits produce debias_valid and supply debias_data for sampling.
signals.evidence: debias_sreg <= debias_sreg(0) & cell_sum on rising_edge(clk_i); debias_valid and debias_data derived from debias_sreg.

signals.name: debias_state
signals.functionality: Captured on clock as (not debias_state) AND the MSB of cell_en_out; used with debias_sreg to form debias_valid. Reset clears this register.
signals.evidence: debias_state <= (not debias_state) and cell_en_out(cell_en_out'left) on rising_edge(clk_i); reset branch sets debias_state <= '0'.

signals.name: debias_valid
signals.functionality: Combinationally derived from debias_state AND the XOR of debias_sreg bits; it gates sampling counter increment and shift-register updates when asserted.
signals.evidence: debias_valid <= debias_state and (debias_sreg(1) xor debias_sreg(0)); used in sampling_control if (debias_valid = '1') then ...

signals.name: debias_data
signals.functionality: Combinationally taken as debias_sreg(0); it is XORed into the sampling shift register to produce whitened sampled bits.
signals.evidence: debias_data <= debias_sreg(0); used in sample_sreg update sample_sreg <= ... & (sample_sreg(7) xor debias_data).

signals.name: sample_en
signals.functionality: Captured from external enable_i at clock edge; its registered value drives cell_en_in(0) combinationally and is tested in sampling_control to reset or allow sampling.
signals.evidence: sample_en <= enable_i on rising_edge(clk_i); cell_en_in(0) <= sample_en; sampling_control tests sample_en = '0'.

signals.name: sample_sreg
signals.functionality: Shift-register of 8 bits that is cleared on reset, shifted and updated with debias_data on accepted sampling clocks, and whose full contents are exported on data_o.
signals.evidence: sample_sreg <= sample_sreg(6 downto 0) & (sample_sreg(7) xor debias_data) on rising_edge(clk_i); data_o <= sample_sreg.

signals.name: sample_cnt
signals.functionality: Counts accepted debias_valid events by incrementing each clock when debias_valid='1'; it resets on disable or when its MSB becomes '1', and its MSB is exported as valid_o.
signals.evidence: sample_cnt incremented std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(sample_cnt)+1) on debias_valid; tested sample_cnt(sample_cnt'left) = '1' in sampling_control; valid_o <= sample_cnt(sample_cnt'left).

signals.name: sreg
signals.functionality: Holds NUM_INV bits and shifts in en_i on rising clk_i; it resets to zeros on rstn_i and its MSB is presented on en_o; individual bits gate latch updates.
signals.evidence: en_shift_reg process: reset branch sets sreg<= (others=>'0'); on rising_edge(clk_i) sreg <= sreg(sreg'left-1 downto 0) & en_i

signals.name: latch
signals.functionality: Combinationally selects its value from '0', its own previous value, or inv_out(i) based on en_i and sreg(i); it then supplies the rotated latch vector inv_in.
signals.evidence: concurrent assignment latch(i) <= '0' when (en_i='0') else latch(i) when (sreg(i)='0') else inv_out(i); inv_in <= rotated latch assignments

signals.name: inv_in
signals.functionality: Constructs a rotated view of latch (inv_in(0)=latch(NUM_INV-1), others shifted) and supplies those bits to inv_out computation.
signals.evidence: inv_in(0) <= latch(NUM_INV-1) and inv_in(NUM_INV-1 downto 1) <= latch(NUM_INV-2 downto 0)

signals.name: inv_out
signals.functionality: Drives each bit as logical not of inv_in (combinationally in normal mode); those outputs are the values that latch may sample when enabled.
signals.evidence: inverter_phy: inv_out(i) <= not inv_in(i); latch uses inv_out(i) as one assignment operand

signals.name: sync
signals.functionality: Is reset to zeros on rstn_i and on rising clk_i shifts in latch(latch'left) via sync <= sync(0) & latch(latch'left); its stage sync(1) is exported as rnd_o.
signals.evidence: synchronizer process: reset branch sets sync<= (others=>'0'); on rising_edge(clk_i) sync <= sync(0) & latch(latch'left); rnd_o <= sync(1)
